root_cause_label: Failure to Apply Determinism and Compatibility Patches for Legacy Source Build
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent built POV-Ray 2.2 without applying the required determinism and modern-C compatibility patches, and omitted the scene archive download, producing a binary whose rendered output will fail image-comparison tests even though compilation succeeded.
t_commit_evidence: Step 34: agent renames unixconf.h to config.h and runs make without any patches applied, ignoring the flood of compiler warnings; the resulting unpatched binary is installed in step 35, locking in the failure.
trigger_explanation: The agent never read or sought out any task-level specification about needing determinism patches or the full set of archives. It treated the task as a pure compilation exercise once source was located, ignoring the benchmark requirement that the rendered image match a reference (which requires an RNG seed fix in unix.c). The requirement was implicit in the task setup (legacy software with known non-determinism) but the agent made no attempt to discover or fulfill it.
forewarning_evidence: apt-get source povray -> E: You must put some 'deb-src' URIs in your sources.list
